# Muldrotha, the Gravetide

A primer for the `multi` fixture deck, carrying one instance of each failure
`primer` exists to catch. Every card name is verbatim Scryfall text.

## The commander

[[Muldrotha, the Gravetide]] replays a permanent of each type every turn, so
the deck wants cheap permanents that do not mind dying. [[Eternal Witness]] is
the clearest case, and [[Ashnod's Altar]] turns each replayed body into mana.

Fast mana matters more than usual because the commander costs six:
[[Sol Ring|LEA]] carries a set code, which is display sugar and must not reach
Scryfall as part of the name.

[[Commit // Memory]] is written here with both halves, the way the decklist
spells it; EDHREC would call it "Commit".

## A link a text editor wrapped

The reset that matters against a stalled board is [[Agadeem's
Awakening]], and this link does not render at all — the brackets show up as
literal text in the published page, and the words read correctly in the source
so nothing about proofreading the prose catches it. The card is in the deck.

## A card the list no longer holds

[[Force of Will]] is a real card and is not in this list. This is what a primer
accumulates on its own: cutting a card touches nothing in the paragraph that
argues for it.

## An opener with no closer

This one is last on purpose. An unclosed opener swallows everything up to the
next closing pair anywhere later in the document, so putting it in the middle
would eat the healthy links below it rather than being reported on its own.

Note that this file names no bracket syntax anywhere in its prose: a fixture
that discusses the markup it is parsed for ends up containing links nobody
wrote, and the counts stop meaning what the test says they mean.
